issue.title: interfaces: `findAncestorByHash` returns true for an unknown descendant
issue.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Current behaviour

While testing an external python capnp ipc client on regtest, I found that `findAncestorByHash` returns success for an unknown descendant hash when the ancestor is known. I also reproduced this directly on `master`.


### Expected behaviour

`findAncestorByHash` should return `false` when the descendant hash is unknown

### Steps to reproduce

Add this to the existing `findAncestorByHash` test in `src/test/interfaces_tests.cpp` to reproduce the issue

```cpp
BOOST_CHECK(!chain->findAncestorByHash(uint256{}, active[0]->GetBlockHash()));
```
and then running
```
cmake --build build --target test_bitcoin -j8 && ./build/bin/test_bitcoin --run_test=interfaces_tests/findAncestorByHash
```

### Relevant log output

```
test/interfaces_tests.cpp:97: error: in "interfaces_tests/findAncestorByHash": check !chain->findAncestorByHash(uint256{}, active[0]->GetBlockHash()) has failed
```

### How did you obtain Bitcoin Core

Compiled from source

### What version of Bitcoin Core are you using?

v31.1

### Operating system and version

MacOS 27.0.1 arm

### Machine specifications

_No response_
